id.description: Unique in the map; links and run frames name it.

name.description: The command as a person says it: Map, Review, Mock a flow.

say.description: What the person types or presses to start it, in their words.

gives.description: What they get at the end, in plain words.

lane.description: Layout hint: the column (0 = left). Absent = laid out automatically.

row.description: Layout hint: the row (0 = top). Absent = laid out automatically.
